summary: Two front-range hikers descending Snowmass Mountain's S-Ridge to escape lightning got cliffed out on the west face and activated a Garmin inReach SOS; CBMRT technical team flown in by CareFlight 4 led a 60-meter 5.8 pitch to reach them and lowered them off the cliff with the San Juan Pickoff technique
responding_agency: Crested Butte Mountain Rescue Team; CareFlight 4 (Montrose); High Altitude Army National Guard (standby)
notes: SOS call Sunday 2017-08-13 afternoon; subjects not injured, cold/wet on a small ledge overnight; technical rescue completed morning of 2017-08-14 run-757 merge: coloradosar.org Randy Felix first-person "San Juan Pickoff" CSAR writeup (parent-opened) corroborates the 2017-08-13 Snowmass west-face rescue (S-Ridge lightning, Garmin inReach, CareFlight helo to 12,500 ft, 5.8 pitch).
